search_text: published ZDI-23-1467 ZDI-CAN-18594 Mozilla Firefox JIT Boolean Conversion Uninitialized Variable Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2023-09-27 5.4 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:N ['Mozilla'] ['Firefox'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Mozilla Firefox. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of boolean conversions in the JIT engine. The issue results from the lack of proper initialization of memory prior to accessing it. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. Mozilla has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Mozilla Firefox JIT Boolean Conversion Uninitialized Variable Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Mozilla Firefox. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of boolean conversions in the JIT engine. The issue results from the lack of proper initialization of memory prior to accessing it. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process.
